capabilities: Pair devices with QR codes and word confirmation
Sync encrypted vault records through a host or relay
Preserve conflicting versions for manual review
Restore recovery copies into a separate folder
extras: Paid subscription required for sync; early alpha; source is private; host app and vault must stay open; recovery copies are not a backup.
problem: Users who want encrypted vault sync through their own host computer or server have no built-in Obsidian option.

relations.evidence: Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects carry encrypted note records and manage routing, device authorization and usage limits.

summary: Encrypted vault sync plugin that pairs devices by QR and syncs notes through a user-hosted computer or relay.
